//ConnectionStrings: Same registry database the Packager app uses (DeployToolkit.Core.EfCore / DeployToolkitRegistry). Replace the LocalDB default with your Azure SQL / SQL Server connection string, or override via the ConnectionStrings__Registry environment variable — keep the secret OUT of source control (plan §12).
//Database: Provider=SqlServer in production (migrations live in DeployToolkit.Core.EfCore and are applied at startup). Sqlite is a local-development convenience only.

//Auth.//SeedAdmin: Creates the FIRST ApiUser on startup only when the ApiUsers table is empty. Leave empty to bootstrap by inserting rows by hand instead. Never commit a real production password — the rotation service replaces it on the first cycle anyway.
//Auth.//PasswordRotation: Background service that replaces every active API user's password with a crypto-random one every IntervalMinutes (default 45, per user requirement) — first pass InitialDelaySeconds after startup, which immediately supersedes any seeded/configured password. The CURRENT password is published to App_Data/current-api-password.json (overwritten each cycle, never a history) and, when LogPasswords=true, to the application log — that is how operators/clients learn the new password, since there is deliberately no token flow. Usernames: optional comma-separated filter; empty = all active users.
//Auth.//RateLimit: Per-IP fixed window on /api/auth/* — brute-force backstop.
